A [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|green]] '''reptile'''<ref name="CWA" /> lived on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]],<ref name="Order 66" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]].<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] had four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], which each terminated in three digits, and a long, dexterous tail that it could wrap around [[Tree/Legends|tree]] branches. At its very end, this tail divided into two, curled parts. The reptile had a long, jagged jawline, a stubby [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and large, round, lidded [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A spiky frill ran along the crest of its back from just behind its first shoulder joint down to the start of its tail. An additional frill grew on the final length of tail.<ref name="CWA" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{CWACite|4|Orders (comic story)}} depicts [[Order 66]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> a reptile of this species [[Sleep/Legends|slept]] in a bough near the campfire of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Aiwha Squad]], shortly after the conclusion of the [[Battle of Garqi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Garqi]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reptile appeared in "[[Orders (comic story)|Orders]]," the third story in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 4|fourth volume]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']],<ref name="CWA" /> which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[October 26]], [[2005]]<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/10-920/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-4-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 4 TPB}}</ref> The story was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], penciled by [[Rick Lacy]] and colored by [[Ronda Pattison]].<ref name="CWA" />
